source.name: Pokemon Showdown trainer sprites
source.asset_policy: Sprites are stored unedited. Follow the source index for artist credits and editing restrictions.

trainers.name: Youngster
trainers.intro_line: My Pokemon and I are ready to prove ourselves!

trainers.name: Lass
trainers.intro_line: You should never underestimate a well-trained team!

trainers.name: Bug Catcher
trainers.intro_line: My bugs are tougher than they look!

trainers.name: Camper
trainers.intro_line: A little preparation goes a long way!

trainers.name: Picnicker
trainers.intro_line: This route is my favorite training ground!

trainers.name: Swimmer
trainers.intro_line: My Water Pokemon can handle any current!

trainers.name: Hiker
trainers.intro_line: The mountain made my team rock solid!

trainers.name: Sailor
trainers.intro_line: A double battle is just like weathering a storm!

trainers.name: Channeler
trainers.intro_line: The spirits already know how this battle ends.

trainers.name: Scientist
trainers.intro_line: Your strategy is about to be tested experimentally.

trainers.name: Biker
trainers.intro_line: Nobody rides through my territory without a battle!

trainers.name: Black Belt
trainers.intro_line: Discipline is stronger than luck!

trainers.name: Ace Trainer
trainers.intro_line: I built this team to answer every matchup.

trainers.name: Ace Trainer
trainers.intro_line: Show me whether your team belongs in this league.

trainers.name: Bird Keeper
trainers.intro_line: You will have to look up to keep track of us!

trainers.name: Psychic
trainers.intro_line: I foresaw your arrival. I also foresaw my victory.

trainers.name: Pokemon Tamer
trainers.intro_line: Raw power means nothing without control.

trainers.name: Dragon Tamer
trainers.intro_line: Only a fearless trainer can command dragons.

trainers.name: Brock
trainers.intro_line: My rock-hard willpower is evident even in my Pokemon.

trainers.name: Misty
trainers.intro_line: My policy is an all-out offensive with Water Pokemon!

trainers.name: Lt. Surge
trainers.intro_line: I will shock you into surrender!

trainers.name: Erika
trainers.intro_line: Beautiful flowers can hide formidable strength.

trainers.name: Koga
trainers.intro_line: Despair at the invisible terror of poison!

trainers.name: Sabrina
trainers.intro_line: I knew you would come. Let us test what you have learned.

trainers.name: Blaine
trainers.intro_line: My fiery Pokemon will incinerate all challengers!

trainers.name: Giovanni
trainers.intro_line: A child cannot hope to understand true power.

trainers.name: Lorelei
trainers.intro_line: No one can best me when it comes to icy Pokemon.

trainers.name: Bruno
trainers.intro_line: We will grind you down with our superior power!

trainers.name: Agatha
trainers.intro_line: Pokemon are for battling. I will show you how a real trainer fights.

trainers.name: Lance
trainers.intro_line: You know that dragons are mythical Pokemon. They are hard to catch and raise, but their powers are superior.

trainers.name: Blue
trainers.intro_line: My team is perfectly balanced. This is where your run ends.

trainers.name: Falkner
trainers.intro_line: Ha! I'll show you the real power of the magnificent bird Pokemon!

trainers.name: Bugsy
trainers.intro_line: I never lose when it comes to bug Pokemon!

trainers.name: Whitney
trainers.intro_line: Everyone was into Pokemon, so I got into it too!

trainers.name: Morty
trainers.intro_line: I can see what you cannot. Allow me to show you.

trainers.name: Chuck
trainers.intro_line: Watch this! I'll shatter a boulder with my bare hands!

trainers.name: Jasmine
trainers.intro_line: Um... I have to fight you. Please, do your best.

trainers.name: Pryce
trainers.intro_line: Winter has taught me more than any trainer ever could.

trainers.name: Clair
trainers.intro_line: I am the world's best dragon master. You will regret challenging me.

trainers.name: Will
trainers.intro_line: I have trained all around the world, and my psychic Pokemon are flawless.

trainers.name: Koga
trainers.intro_line: Poison slowly saps the strength of its victim. A ninja's way is patience.

trainers.name: Bruno
trainers.intro_line: We will grind you down with our superior power!

trainers.name: Karen
trainers.intro_line: Strong Pokemon. Weak Pokemon. That is only the selfish perception of people.

trainers.name: Lance
trainers.intro_line: I've been waiting for you. My dragons will not fall so easily.

trainers.name: Roxanne
trainers.intro_line: I became a Gym Leader so I might apply what I learned at the Trainer's School.

trainers.name: Brawly
trainers.intro_line: I've been churning up a really big, big wave! Let's see if you can ride it!

trainers.name: Wattson
trainers.intro_line: Wahahahah! I'll give you a thorough shock treatment!

trainers.name: Flannery
trainers.intro_line: I'll show you the hot moves my grandfather taught me!

trainers.name: Norman
trainers.intro_line: I'm proud of you for making it this far. Now, show me everything you have.

trainers.name: Winona
trainers.intro_line: I have become one with bird Pokemon. Now, come. Let us dance.

trainers.name: Tate & Liza
trainers.intro_line: We're twins, so we know exactly what the other is thinking.

trainers.name: Juan
trainers.intro_line: Now, shall we begin our elegant water ballet?

trainers.name: Sidney
trainers.intro_line: I like that look you're giving me. Let's get on with it!

trainers.name: Phoebe
trainers.intro_line: I trained on Mt. Pyre, where I learned to commune with ghost Pokemon.

trainers.name: Glacia
trainers.intro_line: I've travelled far from a distant land to master ice. Show me your fire.

trainers.name: Drake
trainers.intro_line: Do you know what it takes to command dragon Pokemon? You will learn.

trainers.name: Steven
trainers.intro_line: I collect rare stones. Today, I'm interested in what you're made of.

trainers.name: Beauty
trainers.intro_line: My Pokemon and I are the picture of grace!

trainers.name: Fisherman
trainers.intro_line: Whatever bites, I reel it in!

trainers.name: Rocker
trainers.intro_line: Let's crank this battle up to eleven!

trainers.name: Cue Ball
trainers.intro_line: No fancy tricks. Just fists!

trainers.name: Burglar
trainers.intro_line: Heh heh... your Pokemon look valuable.

trainers.name: Engineer
trainers.intro_line: My circuits are buzzing for a battle!

trainers.name: Juggler
trainers.intro_line: Watch closely - now you see them, now you don't!

trainers.name: Crush Girl
trainers.intro_line: My chops can split bricks - and defenses!

trainers.name: PokeManiac
trainers.intro_line: My collection is stronger than it looks!

trainers.name: Gentleman
trainers.intro_line: A gentleman never refuses a proper duel.

trainers.name: Psychic Dahlia
trainers.intro_line: I foresaw this battle... and its ending.

trainers.name: Beauty
trainers.intro_line: Elegance wins battles as often as power.

trainers.name: PokeFan
trainers.intro_line: My darlings are simply the cutest - and toughest!

trainers.name: PokeFan Alma
trainers.intro_line: Wait till you see my precious team!

trainers.name: Boarder
trainers.intro_line: Fresh powder, fresh battle. Let's carve!

trainers.name: Firebreather
trainers.intro_line: My flames never go out!

trainers.name: Guitarist
trainers.intro_line: Feel that riff? That's the sound of defeat!

trainers.name: Juggler
trainers.intro_line: Round and round the Poke Balls go!

trainers.name: Medium Grace
trainers.intro_line: The spirits whisper of your defeat...

trainers.name: Kimono Girl
trainers.intro_line: Every dance tells a story. This one ends in victory.

trainers.name: Gentleman
trainers.intro_line: Shall we settle this with dignity?

trainers.name: Aroma Lady
trainers.intro_line: Take a deep breath... then battle!

trainers.name: Ninja Boy
trainers.intro_line: You'll never see my team coming!

trainers.name: PokeFan
trainers.intro_line: I cheer loudest for my own Pokemon!

trainers.name: Swimmer Marina
trainers.intro_line: The tide is coming in - can you keep up?

trainers.name: Collector
trainers.intro_line: You're about to see some rare finds!

trainers.name: Bug Maniac
trainers.intro_line: My bugs are magnificent! Look closer!

trainers.name: Hex Maniac
trainers.intro_line: I put a little curse on this battle...

trainers.name: Kindler
trainers.intro_line: Every spark can become a wildfire!

trainers.name: Parasol Lady
trainers.intro_line: Rain or shine, I never lose!

trainers.name: Ruin Maniac
trainers.intro_line: The ancients taught me a trick or two!

trainers.name: Battle Girl
trainers.intro_line: Fast feet, faster fists!

trainers.name: Expert
trainers.intro_line: Decades of study led to this moment.

trainers.name: Expert Mira
trainers.intro_line: Let me show you what mastery means.

trainers.name: Ace Duo
trainers.intro_line: Two hearts, one strategy - no openings!

trainers.name: Cooltrainer Gaven
trainers.intro_line: I've trained for this my whole life!

trainers.name: Cooltrainer Irene
trainers.intro_line: My team is drilled to perfection!

trainers.name: Ace Trainer
trainers.intro_line: The Hoenn circuit made me sharp. Your move!

trainers.name: Ace Trainer Jody
trainers.intro_line: I don't drop battles to anyone!

trainers.name: Youngster
trainers.intro_line: Shorts season never ends in Sinnoh!

trainers.name: Lass
trainers.intro_line: My Pokemon and I never back down!

trainers.name: School Kid
trainers.intro_line: I studied for this battle all week!

trainers.name: Poke Kid
trainers.intro_line: Pika pika! My team is the cutest AND the strongest!

trainers.name: Idol Grace
trainers.intro_line: Sing along if you know the words to defeat!

trainers.name: Fisherman
trainers.intro_line: The lakes of Sinnoh taught me patience!

trainers.name: Hiker
trainers.intro_line: Mt. Coronet made these legs - and this team!

trainers.name: Black Belt
trainers.intro_line: Every strike carries my spirit!

trainers.name: Scientist
trainers.intro_line: My data says you lose in four turns.

trainers.name: Psychic
trainers.intro_line: Your strategy arrived in my mind before you did.

trainers.name: Reporter Roxy
trainers.intro_line: This battle is going straight to the evening news!

trainers.name: Roughneck
trainers.intro_line: My head's shaved, my team's mean. Let's go.

trainers.name: Galactic Grunt
trainers.intro_line: For the glory of Team Galactic!

trainers.name: Galactic Grunt Nea
trainers.intro_line: The new universe has no room for losers like you!

trainers.name: Beauty
trainers.intro_line: Grace under pressure - watch closely!

trainers.name: Ace Trainer Dennis
trainers.intro_line: I train where blizzards are born!

trainers.name: Ace Trainer Maya
trainers.intro_line: My team swept the Battle Tower. You're next.

trainers.name: Battle Girl
trainers.intro_line: Veilstone's dojo sends its regards!

trainers.name: Roark
trainers.intro_line: This gym was carved by fossils and grit!

trainers.name: Gardenia
trainers.intro_line: The forest is watching us. Let's make it proud!

trainers.name: Fantina
trainers.intro_line: Ohohoho! Dance with my ghosts!

trainers.name: Maylene
trainers.intro_line: My fists trained on stone!

trainers.name: Crasher Wake
trainers.intro_line: Crash! Splash! Crasher Wake!

trainers.name: Byron
trainers.intro_line: Steel is patience given form!

trainers.name: Candice
trainers.intro_line: The cold sharpens everything!

trainers.name: Volkner
trainers.intro_line: Give me a battle worth waking up for!

trainers.name: Cyrus
trainers.intro_line: The universe will be reborn without spirit.

trainers.name: Aaron
trainers.intro_line: My bugs are strongest because they are underestimated.

trainers.name: Bertha
trainers.intro_line: This old lady still has firm ground under her.

trainers.name: Flint
trainers.intro_line: Let's burn this room down to the wick!

trainers.name: Lucian
trainers.intro_line: I have already read this battle's final page.

trainers.name: Cynthia
trainers.intro_line: Show me everything you have.

trainers.name: Veteran Brice
trainers.intro_line: Decades of leagues live in these commands.

trainers.name: Commander Mars
trainers.intro_line: Team Galactic doesn't lose to wandering trainers.

trainers.name: Commander Jupiter
trainers.intro_line: You're an obstacle. Obstacles get removed.

trainers.name: Commander Saturn
trainers.intro_line: Cyrus demands results. I deliver them.
